title: LineageRAG: Harnessing GraphRAG by Constructing Evidence Lineages with Source Grounding
abstract: arXiv:2608.16004v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Graph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) retrieves evidence for multi-hop questions over structured cor- pus graphs. Existing GraphRAG methods leave the connection between evidence discovery and source grounding implicit. We propose LineageRAG, which constructs one evidence lin- eage for each query-derived evidence demand and completes it with a verbatim source span when the selected evidence supports that demand. LineageRAG first initializes the evi- dence demands. It then expands each lineage through demand- conditioned retrieval over the corpus graph while retaining the demand associated with every candidate. Lineage completion uses this provenance to select complementary passages and grounds supported demands in verbatim source text. Experi- ments on HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, and MuSiQue show that LineageRAG improves R@5, EM, and F1 by 3.51, 5.96, and 5.22 points on average over leading GraphRAG baselines.

translated_title: LineageRAG：通过构建带来源锚定的证据谱系来利用GraphRAG
translated_abstract: 基于图的检索增强生成（GraphRAG）在结构化语料库图上检索多跳问题的证据。现有的GraphRAG方法在证据发现与来源锚定之间的联系上留有意隐性。我们提出了LineageRAG，它为每个查询衍生的证据需求构建一个证据谱系，并在所选证据支持该需求时，用逐字来源片段完成该谱系。LineageRAG首先初始化证据需求。然后，它通过基于需求的语料库图检索扩展每个谱系，同时保留每个候选者关联的需求。谱系完成利用这一来源信息选择互补段落，并将支持的需求锚定在逐字来源文本中。在HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA和MuSiQue上的实验表明，与领先的GraphRAG基线相比，LineageRAG在R@5、EM和F1上平均提高了3.51、5.96和5.22个百分点。
tldr: LineageRAG通过为每个证据需求构建并完成带逐字来源锚定的证据谱系，显著提升了GraphRAG在多跳问答中的检索和生成性能。
en_tdlr: LineageRAG enhances GraphRAG by constructing and completing evidence lineages with verbatim source grounding for each query-derived demand, boosting multi-hop QA performance.
